newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Agenda for Saturday's Dublin summit.
newsitem.headline: Agenda for Saturday's Dublin summit.

text.p: European Union leaders meet for an informal summit in Dublin on Saturday to discuss progress in the inter-governmental conference (IGC), a treaty review designed to prepare the bloc for the future. Here is the agenda (all times GMT):
1800: The prime ministers of Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg -- Jean-Luc Dehaene, Wim Kok and Jean-Claude Juncker -- hold their traditional pre-European Union summit meeting.

0930: Irish Foreign Minister Dick Spring hosts summit of European socialist leaders. Attendees include the Netherlands' Kok, Denmark's Poul Nyrup Rasmussen, Sweden's Goran Persson, Greece's Costas Simitis, Portugal's Antonio Guterres and Finland's Paavo Lipponen.
1215: EU leaders arrive at Dublin Castle for summit.

1245: Working lunch for leaders and European Commission President Jacques Santer. Irish Prime Minister John Bruton to report on Irish EU presidency priorities, followed by informal exchange of views on the IGC.
EU foreign ministers to meet over lunch at same time.
1500: EU leaders meet European Parliament President Klaus Haensch.
1512: EU leaders formal session begins. Progress report on IGC to be given by Spring.
1800: News conference by Irish EU presidency, followed by individual news conferences by EU leaders

Working dinner of EU leaders and separate dinner for EU foreign ministers. Bruton to report on recent visit to United States and Japan. Also planned discussion of Russia and central and eastern Europe.
